title: Caiado Promises Transformative Government and Structural Reforms
subtitle: PSD presidential candidate says his platform will be transformative
excerpt: PSD candidate Ronaldo Caiado pledges that, if elected, his administration will be transformative and carry out structural reforms.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado maintains that, should he win the election, he will deliver a transformative administration and political platform.

In addition to his pledge of sweeping change, his agenda includes pursuing structural reforms.

Caiado pairs his background as a physician and rural producer with extensive legislative experience, having been elected federal deputy five times and senator once.

With information from Agência Brasil.
